clips.dialogue:
Mia: What do you do on weekends, Leo?
Leo: I usually play badminton on Saturday mornings.
Mia: That sounds fun! What about Sundays?
Leo: I visit my grandparents on Sundays. We read books together.
Mia: I like reading too. This Saturday, I will have a picnic in the park.
Leo: Great! What time?
Mia: At ten in the morning.
clips.story: My name is Mia. I usually read a book at home on Saturdays. This Saturday is different. My friend Leo and I will have a picnic in the park at ten in the morning. I will bring some sandwiches and apples. Leo will bring water and a badminton set. We want to play badminton before lunch. My little brother Ben will come too. He likes drawing, so he will bring his pencils. After lunch, we will read a story under a big tree. I like the park because it is quiet and green. A good weekend does not have to be busy. Sometimes, time with friends is enough.
clips.speaking: I usually play badminton with my friends on Saturdays. I like it because it is fun. What do you do on weekends?
